errors.text_span: The horizontal axis displays the model names, listed alphabetically from left to right, while the vertical axis represents the percentage score
errors.evidence: The chart is a horizontal bar chart, so the model names (categories) are on the vertical axis, and the percentages are represented by the length of the bars along the horizontal axis. The description has swapped the axes.

errors.text_span: listed alphabetically from left to right
errors.evidence: The categories on the vertical axis ('EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0' and 'RedWhale (our)') are not listed alphabetically.
The value axis is not shown, but it would range from 0 to 100 (percent). The range 1.4 to 95.7 is fabricated from individual data points within the bars.

errors.text_span: The value axis is labeled “Score (%)” and contains tick marks every 10 percentage points, beginning at 1.4 and ending at 95.7.
errors.evidence: The figure does not contain an axis label for the value axis, nor does it have any tick marks. The entire description of the value axis is fabricated.

errors.text_span: The tallest bar, representing RedWhale (our), has a value of 95.7
errors.evidence: This is a stacked bar chart where each bar sums to 100%. The value 95.7 is only for the 'Correct' segment of the 'RedWhale (our)' bar, not the value of the entire bar. Also, for a horizontal bar chart, 'longest' is the more appropriate term than 'tallest'.

errors.text_span: with a partially incorrect section colored pale blue and a completely incorrect section colored light blue.
errors.evidence: The legend defines the categories as 'Partially Correct' (medium purple) and 'Incorrect' (light blue). The description invents new category names ('partially incorrect', 'completely incorrect') and colors ('pale blue').

errors.text_span: The bar for EEVe-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 has a value of 92.9
errors.evidence: This is a stacked bar chart where each bar sums to 100%. The value 92.9 is only for the 'Correct' segment of the 'EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0' bar, not the value of the entire bar.

errors.text_span: with a partially correct section colored purple and a completely incorrect section colored pale blue.
errors.evidence: The description misidentifies categories and colors. The 'Partially Correct' segment is medium purple (value 2.9), and the 'Incorrect' segment is light blue (value 4.3). The description invents the category 'completely incorrect' and the color 'pale blue'.

errors.text_span: The bar for EEVe-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 has a value of 2.9 and a completely incorrect section colored pale blue, while RedWhale (our) has a value of 1.4 and a partially incorrect section colored lilac.
errors.evidence: This sentence is highly confused. It correctly states the values 2.9 and 1.4 for the 'Partially Correct' sections but mislabels the categories as 'completely incorrect' and 'partially incorrect'. It also invents colors 'pale blue' and 'lilac' which are not in the legend.
The description fails to mention the legend, which is essential for understanding what the different colored segments of the stacked bars represent ('Correct', 'Partially Correct', 'Incorrect').
The description does not explicitly state that the chart uses a stacked bar structure. It incorrectly treats the bars as simple bars by assigning a single value to them, leading to confusion.

errors.text_span: All bars are unshaded and similarly sized
errors.evidence: While the total length of the stacked bars is similar (representing 100%), the preceding sentences describe the bars as if they were simple bars with different values (95.7 vs 92.9). This makes the claim that they are 'similarly sized' contradictory and confusing to the reader.
